'''Jared Brown''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Australasian Continental Championship]] on 16 July 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court with bounty hunters]], according to Michael Josem's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1013">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7d1013/ asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7], DeckTech (Michael "Joz" Josem, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-asia-pacific-championships-sydney-16-7d1013/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
